content: Amooneta Xooneteth
Hessafe guye Amooneta kawoy hayqqides; iza naa Haanooney izasohon kawotides.

Dawitikka, «Iza aaway taas kiya ooththidayssaththo tanikka Na7oose naa Haanoones iza kushe zaarana» gi qoppides. Hessa gishshas iza aawa hayqo gishshas mishettidayssa yootana mala Dawiti as kiittides; Dawiti yeddida asati biidi Amoone dere gakkida mala,

Amoone dere shuumeti ba godaa Haanoone, «Dawiti baas seetettida mishaa qonccisanaas as kiittiday ne aawa bonchchanaas kiittidaa nees misatizee? Izi kiittida asati katamayo paacci xeellanaas, xomosanaassinne dhayssanaas gidennee?» gida.
Hessa gishshas Haanooney Dawite asata oykkidi issaa issaa buuch baggasi meedides; istti may7ida may7ozakka pude xeessa gaththi qanxxi yeddides.
Asati keehi yeellatidayssa Dawiti siyida gishshas as isttas kiittides; kawozi, «Intte buuchchay diccanaashe gakkanaas Iyarkkon gam7idi hessafe guye simmi yiite» gides.
Amoone asay Dawiti istta ixxidayssa eridi Beet-Era7aabeppenne Xoobbafe 20,000 Aaraameppe tohora biza wottadarata hessaththoka kawo Ma7ikay 1,000 asaara qasseka Xoobbafe 12,000 as qaxxarida.
Dawiti hessa siyidi Iyo7aabe kumeththa ola asaara gaththi yeddides.
Amoone asay kezidi ba katama geliza penge bolla salfen eqqides; Xoobba asay, Erahoobe asay, hessaththoka Xoobbiya asaynne Ma7ika asay demba bolla dumma salfida.
Iyo7aabeykka guyeranne sinththara olay bana giddoththidayssa be7idi Isra7eele garsan erettida olanchchatappe guuththata dooridi Aaraame olanchchata sinththan aaththi essides.
Hankko attida olanchchata ba isha Abisaye istta bolla shuumidi Amoone asaa sinththan essides.
Iyo7aabeykka, «Aaraame asay ta bolla minniko ne yaada tana maadda; Amoone asay ne bolla minniko ta baada nena maaddana.
Hessa gishshas minna! Nuni nu derezasinne nu Xoossa katamatas ane minni olettoos; GODAY bana lo7ida mala ooththo» gides.
Hessafe guye Iyo7aabeynne izara diza ola asay Aaraame asaa olanaas gede sinth hordofides; Aaraame asay istta sinththafe baqatides.
Aaraame asay baqatidayssa Amoone asay be7idi isttika Abisaye sinththafe baqatidi gede katamay giddo gelida; hessa gishshas Iyo7aabey Amoone asaa olizayssa aggaagidi guye Yerusalaame simmides.
Aaraame asay Isra7eele asaan xoonettidayssa be7idi qasseka issi bolla shiiqida.
Hadaadi7eezere asata kiittidi shaafappe he pinththan diza Aaraame asaa ehisides; isttika Hadaadi7eezere ola asaa azaziza Soobake alaafeteththan Elaame bida.
Dawiti hessa siyidi kumeththa Isra7eele asaa shiishshides; hessafe guye Yordaanoose pinnidi Elaame bides; Aaraame asay olas giigettidi Dawitera tiran gayttides.

Gido attiin istti Isra7eele sinththafe baqatida; Dawiti isttafe 700 para-gaare asatanne 40,000 tohon biza olanchchata wodhides. Hessaththo istti ola asaa azaziza Soobakekka caddi madunththida gishshas izi heen hayqqides.
Hadaadi7eezereppe garsara diza kawoti ubbay Isra7eele asaan xoonettidayssa be7idi Isra7eele asaara saroteth medhdhidi isttas haarettida. Hessa gishshas Aaraame asay Amoone asaa maaddanaas babbides.
